messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, or a heart defect"
set: ["in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, or a heart defect", "risk in people with heart defect", "heart problems, heart disease, heart defects, high blood pressure, family history of sudden death or heart problems", "congenital heart defect", "closing a certain heart defect", "people with heart disease", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "risk in people with heart disease", "people with coronary heart disease", "people with high blood pressure", "risk in people with high blood pressure", "tell doctor if ever had heart disease, congestive heart failure", "heart attack or stroke in people without heart disease or risk factors", "blood pressure or heart rate", "people with stable blood pressure and circulation after heart attack", "heart failure or other heart problems"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
